signup.emailHint: We'll send a link to confirm it.
forgot.title: Forgot your password?
forgot.subtitle: Enter the email on your account and we'll send a reset link.
forgot.sentBody: If a verified account uses that address, a reset link is on its way. It works for one hour.
reset.incompleteHint: Open the link from your email again, or request a new one.

reset.subtitle: You'll be signed out everywhere and can sign in with the new password.
reset.signInWithNew: Sign in with your new password

verify.failedHint: Sign in and choose Resend the link for a fresh one.
confirmChange.title: Confirm your new email
confirmChange.doneBody: You were signed out on every device. Sign in with your new email.
confirmChange.failedHint: Your email was not changed. Sign in and ask for a new link under Settings.
emailWhen.title: Email me when…
emailWhen.label: Email me when
emailWhen.auth_failed: the game rejects an account's password
emailWhen.crash_loop: a bot is stopped after repeated crashes
emailWhen.shutoff: the shutoff timer stops a bot
emailWhen.plan_expiring: my plan is about to end
emailWhen.sentTo: Emails go to {{email}}. Each of these also shows under the bell, whatever you choose here.
emailWhen.unverified: Confirm your email address to get these. Until then they only show under the bell.
settings.password.title: Change password
settings.password.done: Password changed. Your other devices were signed out.
changeEmail.title: Change email
changeEmail.current: Your email is {{email}}. You sign in with it and get your account emails there.
changeEmail.sentBody: We sent a link to {{sentTo}}. It works for 1 hour. Your email stays {{current}} until you open it. Opening it signs you out on every device, and you sign in again with the new address.
export.title: Your data
export.body: Download a JSON file of everything stored about you: your profile, game accounts and their settings, run history, logs, notifications and your own actions. Game passwords are never included.
delete.title: Delete account
delete.body: This stops your bots and permanently deletes your account, game accounts, settings, logs and notifications. It can't be undone.
delete.modalBody: Your bots stop and everything is deleted for good. Enter your password and type your username, {{username}}, to confirm.
dashboard.title: Your accounts
dashboard.selectionOverLimit: The selection includes accounts over your plan limit. {{hint}}
dashboard.removeBody: Their bots stop and their settings are deleted. This can't be undone.
dashboard.overLimit_one: {{count, number}} account is over your plan limit and can't start. {{hint}}
dashboard.overLimit_other: {{count, number}} accounts are over your plan limit and can't start. {{hint}}

dashboard.planAllows_other: Your plan allows {{count, number}} bots. Remove one to add another. Event twins are free.
dashboard.emptyHint: Add a game account to start running bots.
dashboard.twinTip: Add event twin: free, plays the temporary event server
drawer.discardBody: The changes you made to this account haven't been saved.
drawer.passwordHintNew: Stored encrypted. Nobody can read it back, admins included.
drawer.passwordHintEdit: Leave empty to keep the current password.
drawer.eventHint: Plays the temporary event server. Pair it with this account's normal twin for the fastest start.
schedule.off: Without a schedule the bot runs whenever it is started.
schedule.intro: The bot runs only inside these windows while it is started, and sleeps between them.

schedule.jitter_other: Vary start and stop times by up to {{count, number}} minutes each day

plan.current.over_other: {{count, number}} accounts are over the limit and stay stopped.

plan.buy.noneHint: Contact support to buy, or redeem a code if a friend gave you one.
